About Tuba Trims

Garment trims manufacturer in Bangladesh you can rely on.

Tuba Trims manufactures belts, patches, badges, zipper pullers, buttons and custom garment accessories in Dhaka. Founded in 2015 by Golam Kibria Chowdhury and led by Managing Director Tareq Chowdhury, we supply garment factories and buyers across Bangladesh with reliable quality and on-time delivery.

Our story

Built to be Bangladesh’s dependable garment trims partner.

Tuba Trims was founded in 2015 by Golam Kibria Chowdhury, with his son Tareq Chowdhury leading the business as Managing Director. Their goal was clear: give garment factories in Bangladesh a dependable local source for trims and accessories that match the approved sample every time and ship on schedule.

From a first unit in Dhaka, the company has grown into a dedicated garment trims manufacturer, producing leather and PU belts, woven belts, patches and badges, zipper pullers, buttons, suspenders and custom trims for garment factories in Bangladesh.

“Understand the requirement, make it carefully, and stand behind the work.”
Request a Quote or Sample
  1. 2015

    Tuba Trims begins

    Golam Kibria Chowdhury establishes Tuba Trims at Purana Mugoltuli, Dhaka, with Tareq Chowdhury as Managing Director, to manufacture belts and accessories for garment factories.

  2. Growth

    Focused fully on garment trims

    Under Tareq's leadership the company commits entirely to trims and expands into patches, badges, zipper pullers and buttons, with in-house sample development.

  3. Today

    3,000 sq ft trims factory

    25+ skilled people and 20+ machines handle cutting, stitching, hardware fitting, branding and finishing for buyers and garment factories.

  4. Next

    Growing with our customers

    Continued investment in machinery and faster sampling so buyers can develop and scale new trims with confidence.

Leadership & people

A family-run factory with a 25-strong production team.

Tuba Trims is a family-owned business led by its founder and managing director. Both are involved in the business every day, which means decisions on samples, materials and delivery dates are made quickly and by people who understand the work.

Behind them is a team of more than 25 cutters, machine operators, finishers and quality checkers, many of whom have been with the company for years and have built deep experience in leather, PU, webbing and metal-hardware trims.

Founder

Golam Kibria Chowdhury

Established Tuba Trims in 2015 and set the hands-on, quality-first standard the factory still works to. Continues to guide the company's long-term direction.

Managing Director

Tareq Chowdhury

Leads the business day to day, including customer development, sample approvals, production planning, quality and delivery. He is the direct point of contact for buyers and garment factories.

Direction

Mission, vision and the principles we work by.

Our mission

Give garment factories and brands one local partner for belts, patches, badges, zipper pullers and leather goods — with fast sample development, careful production and straight answers from requirement to delivery.

Our vision

Grow from a trusted Dhaka workshop into a recognised regional manufacturer by investing in people, machinery and documented processes rather than shortcuts.
